quote: As a guideline, we'd expect no more than one per quarter to be sent out. Too many ACKs lose power.
fact: A formal ACK (acknowledgement) process should be sent out no more than about once per quarter, and only by a member of the exec team.

quote: Only 90 days of Slack activity will be retained, so Slack should specifically NOT be used for:
fact: Slack keeps only 90 days of activity, so it must not be used for approvals, documenting decisions, or storing official records.

quote:
Guideline: if you have gone **back and forth 3 times**, it's time
   for a video call.
fact: After going back and forth three times in an issue, email or chat, you should switch to a video call.

quote: Announcements should be made ideally 72 hours (at minimum 24 hours) in advance of a due date.
fact: Time-sensitive company announcements should go out ideally 72 hours, and at least 24 hours, before the due date so APAC/EMEA team members do not miss them.

quote: Announcement that directly impacts less than 75% of team members
fact: An announcement that directly affects fewer than 75% of team members should not go in #company-fyi; it belongs in #whats-happening-at-gitlab.

quote: This gives us meetings of, for example, 25 or 50 minutes leaving some time to:
fact: GitLab prefers the Google Calendar 'speedy meetings' setting, which makes meetings 25 or 50 minutes long instead of 30 or 60.

quote: People are expected to join no later than the scheduled minute of the meeting (before :01 if it is scheduled for :00).
fact: Meetings start on time without waiting; attendees must join before :01 for a meeting scheduled at :00.

quote: you must include the text `[REC]` in the meeting title if you want them to be automatically placed in the `GitLab Videos Recorded` folder in Google Drive on an hourly basis
fact: Zoom cloud recordings are synced hourly to the 'GitLab Videos Recorded' Google Drive folder only if the meeting title contains [REC].

quote: Zoom Chat has been configured for a 30 day retention.
fact: Zoom chat messages are kept for 30 days, so questions during a call should go in the linked document instead of the Zoom chat.

quote: "FY20" is the preferred format and means: Fiscal Year 2020, the period running from February 1, 2019 through January 31, 2020
fact: GitLab's fiscal year runs February 1 to January 31, so FY20 covers February 1, 2019 through January 31, 2020.

quote: Refer to a year with CY18 (never with 2018) and a quarter with CY18-Q1 to prevent confusion with fiscal years and quarters.
fact: Calendar years are written as CY18 and calendar quarters as CY18-Q1, never as a bare 2018, to avoid confusion with fiscal years.

quote: MECEFU is an acronym for Mutually Exclusive Collectively Exhaustive Few words Ubiquitous-language.
fact: MECEFU (pronounced 'MessiFu') stands for Mutually Exclusive, Collectively Exhaustive, Few words, Ubiquitous-language, and describes how GitLab wants domain terms chosen.

quote: US-based team members should not refer to team members outside the US as "international". Instead, use "non-US".
fact: US-based team members should call colleagues outside the US 'non-US', not 'international'.

quote: Do not use cumulative graphs internally.
fact: Cumulative graphs (such as total ARR or total users) should not be used internally because they hide trends; they are only acceptable in external presentations.

quote: 70/30 Rule - Ask open ended questions that leave the audience talking 70% of the time, while you are talking 30% of the time.
fact: In external meetings, the 70/30 rule says the audience should talk 70% of the time and the GitLab team member 30%.

quote: Two Block Rule - For in person meetings with external parties you should wait until you're more than two blocks from the meeting before discussing the results of the meeting.
fact: The Two Block Rule says not to discuss an in-person external meeting until you are more than two blocks away from it.

quote: the general number (+1-650-667-4852), but be aware that this number simply guides to a voice message that refers the caller back to contacting us via email.
fact: GitLab's general phone number is +1-650-667-4852, and it only plays a voice message that tells callers to email instead.

quote: On the 8th of each month (or the next business day), we have a kickoff meeting
fact: The kickoff meeting for the next monthly release is held on the 8th of each month, or the next business day.

quote: If you're new to GitLab and are writing documentation or instructions, submit your first merge request for at most 20 lines.
fact: New team members writing documentation should keep their first merge request to at most 20 lines.

quote: Another good reference is the CEO Shadow [handbook page tips section](/handbook/ceo/shadow/#taking-notes)
fact: For note-taking in general meetings, the communication page recommends the CEO Shadow tip of two note-takers alternating by speaker.

quote: 3 people have 3 communication lines, 4 have 6, and 41 have 820.
fact: The handbook notes that lines of communication grow fast with headcount: 3 people have 3 lines, 4 have 6, and 41 have 820.

quote: Example: "Gotham" was our project name for our IPO, because GitLab would have been penalized for pre-maturely signaling the imminence of its IPO.
fact: 'Gotham' was the code name for GitLab's IPO project, because signaling the IPO early would have been penalized.

quote: "Tiering" was our project name for End of Availability, and "Hamster" was our project name for exploring how to enter China.
fact: 'Tiering' was the code name for End of Availability and 'Hamster' was the code name for exploring entry into China.

quote: Performance improvement plans, disciplinary actions, and individual feedback are restricted, as they may contain negative feedback and [negative feedback is 1-1](/handbook/values/#collaboration) between you and your manager.
fact: Performance improvement plans, disciplinary actions and individual feedback are limited access because of the values rule that negative feedback is 1-1.

quote: Limited access is a more severe restriction than [internal](#internal).
fact: Limited access information is more restricted than internal information and is not shared with all team members.

quote: External channels with no activity in the last year will be removed by CorpSec.
fact: Slack external (ext-) channels with no activity in the last year are removed by CorpSec.

quote: Once a Reverse AMA takes place, a 15-30 minutes debrief meeting should be scheduled immediately following to ensure there is a timely discussion and DRIs are assigned to all actions.
fact: Every Reverse AMA should be followed by a 15-30 minute debrief meeting where DRIs are assigned to all actions.

quote: - A 50 minute closed Zoom call
fact: A Reverse AMA is a 50-minute closed Zoom call in which the E-Group member asks the questions and underrepresented team members answer.

quote: When there's a webinar with the CEO, it is expected that the [CEO Shadows](/handbook/ceo/shadow/) execute the steps outlined in the `when the webinar is over` paragraph.
fact: After a webinar with the CEO, the CEO Shadows are expected to do the post-webinar publishing checklist.

quote: ### E - Explain Calmly
fact: In the P.A.U.S.E. method for managers, the final E stands for Explain Calmly (after Practice Patience, Adjust your Attitude, Understand the Situation, Step Outside).
